_comment: Hand-defined groups, edited by hand (no endpoint writes this file). Format and rules: src/hand_groups.py. A rule only SUGGESTS cards in the edit panel; a member is a person's Add click. Never delete a group: set "retired": true (a tombstone), or every hand placement into it becomes an orphan.

wins-or-loses-the-game.name: Wins, loses or draws the game, or stops it
wins-or-loses-the-game.note: Cards whose own text makes a player win, lose or draw the game, stops a player winning or losing it, or replaces the loss. Read against all 107 text matches and the 10 tag-only cards on 2026-10-15: the poison reminder line ("A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.") is excluded by the 'not' entry; the weak 'has lost the game' references are not matched; no tag rule (8 of the 10 tag-only cards were not about the game's result).

votes-an-additional-time.name: Votes an additional time
votes-an-additional-time.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that give their controller an extra vote while voting (4 matches: The Valeyard, Ballot Broker, Brago's Representative and Tivit). The broader group is the community-tag group "Voting" (25 cards), which fits these cards too; this one is named for what the cards do. Phase 2: the parser has no field for a vote count or for extra votes.

opens-or-visits-attractions.name: Opens or visits Attractions
opens-or-visits-attractions.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that open, visit or count Attractions (Unfinity). Phase 2: the parser does not know Attractions, 'open an Attraction' or 'visit'.

cares-about-the-draft.name: Cares about the draft
cares-about-the-draft.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Conspiracy-style draft-matters cards (draft this card face up, reveal as you draft, note who passed it). The 'not' entry 'spellbook' leaves out the Alchemy cards that say 'draft a card from its spellbook', a different mechanic. Phase 2: draft-time rules are outside the game rules the parser models.

conspiracy-starts-in-command-zone.name: Conspiracy that starts in the command zone
conspiracy-starts-in-command-zone.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Conspiracy cards that start the game in the command zone, face up or face down (hidden and double agenda). Phase 2: no field for starting the game with a card in the command zone.

any: start the game with this conspiracy
conspiracy face up in the command zone

plays-for-ante.name: Plays for ante
plays-for-ante.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that say 'remove this card from your deck before playing if you're not playing for ante' and ante a card. Read the first version of this rule ("ante ") on 2026-10-16: it matched 'enchanted' on 1,435 cards, so the phrases are the four above, which match 9 cards. Phase 2: the ante zone is not modelled.

cares-about-face-down-creatures.name: Cares about face-down creatures
cares-about-face-down-creatures.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that look at, turn up, count, or give something to face-down creatures or permanents, without being morph, manifest or disguise cards themselves. No 'not' list: one that listed morph or manifest removed two true matches. Phase 2: no field for the face-down state of another permanent.

gives-landwalk.name: Gives landwalk
gives-landwalk.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that give a creature a landwalk ability, for a turn or for good (35 matches; 29 are already placed in groups for gaining a keyword). Split from 'Ignores or removes landwalk' on 2026-10-16. Phase 2: landwalk is a keyword to the parser, but a land type chosen or given is not.

ignores-or-removes-landwalk.name: Ignores or removes landwalk
ignores-or-removes-landwalk.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that let creatures with landwalk be blocked as though they didn't have it, or take landwalk away (10 matches). Phase 2: no field for 'blocked as though it didn't have' an ability.

any: blocked as though they didn't have

cast-only-after-another-spell.name: Can only be cast after another spell
cast-only-after-another-spell.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Spells that can only be cast if you have cast another spell this turn (3 cards, all unplaced when read). Phase 2: the parser keeps no condition on casting a spell.

any: only if you've cast another spell this turn
only if you have cast another spell this turn

cant-have-counters-put-on-it.name: Can't have counters put on it
cant-have-counters-put-on-it.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that cannot have counters put on them (4 matches). Phase 2: counter prevention is not a field.

stops-library-searches.name: Stops or limits library searches
stops-library-searches.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that stop players searching libraries or cut a search to the top cards (5 matches; the pool outside the pile is Mindlock Orb, Leonin Arbiter and Shadow of Doubt). Phase 2: search restrictions are not a field.

play-with-hands-revealed.name: Players play with their hands revealed
play-with-hands-revealed.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against every match in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that make a player play with their hand revealed (8 matches). Phase 2: a continuing 'reveal your hand' state is not a field.

chooses-a-side-as-it-enters.name: Chooses between two named options as it enters
chooses-a-side-as-it-enters.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 14 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Permanents that ask for a choice between two named sides as they enter, each side with its own abilities (the Tarkir Siege cycle and the cards built the same way). The rule lists the ten pairs found; a new cycle needs its pair added. Phase 2: a choice between two named sides as the permanent enters, each side with its own abilities, is not a field.

takes-the-initiative.name: Takes or cares about the initiative
takes-the-initiative.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 26 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that take the initiative or care about having it. Phase 2: the initiative and its dungeon are not modelled.

controls-another-players-turn.name: Controls another player's turn
controls-another-players-turn.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 8 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that let you control another player's turn. Phase 2: taking over a player's turn is not a field.

any: you control target player during that player's next turn

sacrifices-the-rest.name: Each player keeps some permanents and sacrifices the rest
sacrifices-the-rest.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 20 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards where each player chooses some permanents to keep and sacrifices the rest (Cataclysm, Balance-style and Single Combat effects). Phase 2: choosing what to keep and sacrificing the rest is not a field.

any: sacrifices all other nonland permanents they control

draws-for-the-biggest-creature.name: Rewards having the creature with the greatest power or toughness
draws-for-the-biggest-creature.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 8 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that draw a card or reward you if you control the creature with the greatest power or toughness. Phase 2: a comparison with every creature on the battlefield is not a condition the parser keeps.

any: if you control the creature with the greatest
control a creature with the greatest power among
control the creature with the greatest toughness

teamwork.name: Teamwork
teamwork.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 19 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards with the Teamwork additional cost, or that care about paying it. Phase 2: the Teamwork additional cost (tap creatures for their total power) is not a field.

choose-modes-by-points.name: Chooses modes worth a total of five points
choose-modes-by-points.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 5 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Season spells that choose up to five points of modes. Phase 2: choosing modes by point cost ({P}) is not a field.

nonbasic-lands-change-type.name: Makes nonbasic lands another land type
nonbasic-lands-change-type.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 4 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that make every nonbasic land another land type. Phase 2: setting the land type of a whole class of lands is not a field.

limits-attackers-or-blockers.name: Limits how many creatures can attack or block
limits-attackers-or-blockers.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 8 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that cap how many creatures can attack or block. Phase 2: a cap on the number of attackers or blockers is not a field.

any: no more than one creature can attack
no more than two creatures can attack
no more than one creature can block
no more than two creatures can block
creatures can attack you each combat

puts-exiled-cards-in-graveyard.name: Puts an opponent's exiled card into their graveyard
puts-exiled-cards-in-graveyard.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 9 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards with the Process action: put an opponent's exiled card into their graveyard. Phase 2: the Process action (moving an opponent's exiled card to their graveyard) is not a field.

any: put a card an opponent owns from exile into that player's graveyard

damage-from-a-chosen-source.name: Prevents or redirects damage from a source of your choice
damage-from-a-chosen-source.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 32 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that prevent or redirect the next damage from a source you choose (Circle and Rune of Protection and kin). The community tag group 'Prevents damage to you' holds 17 of the matches; the other matches are not in it. Phase 2: choosing the damage source at resolution is not a field.

any: source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn
source of your choice would deal damage to you

sweep-returns-lands.name: Sweep: returns lands to hand
sweep-returns-lands.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 4 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Sweep spells that return any number of basic lands of one type to hand. Phase 2: the Sweep ability word with a count of returned lands is not a field.

enters-with-a-chosen-keyword-counter.name: Enters with a keyword counter of your choice
enters-with-a-chosen-keyword-counter.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 7 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Creatures that enter with a keyword counter of your choice. The 'not' entries (riot, '+1/+1 counter or haste') remove the 14 Riot cards, whose home is the Riot keyword block; none of them is a member of this mechanic. Phase 2: choosing which keyword counter a permanent enters with is not a field.

any: enters with your choice of a
enters with your choice of two different counters

perpetually-changes-a-card.name: Cards that perpetually gain or get something
perpetually-changes-a-card.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 269 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Alchemy cards that perpetually gain or get something, or change a card for good. Phase 2: 'perpetually' (a lasting change to a card, in any zone) is not a field.

gets-a-boon.name: Gets a boon
gets-a-boon.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 27 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Alchemy cards that give a boon (a delayed trigger with a number of uses). Phase 2: boons (a delayed trigger that lasts for a number of uses) are not a field.

specializes.name: Specializes
specializes.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 64 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Alchemy cards that specialize or unspecialize. Phase 2: specialize and the five specialized forms are not modelled.

has-intensity.name: Has intensity
has-intensity.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 20 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Alchemy cards with starting intensity or that intensify. Phase 2: intensity counters on a card are not a field.

uses-tickets.name: Ticket abilities and costs
uses-tickets.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 70 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that use the {TK} ticket symbol as a counter or a cost. The community tag group 'Place sticker' holds 15 of the matches. Phase 2: the ticket symbol {TK} (a counter and a cost) is not a field.

adds-extra-damage.name: Adds extra damage to your sources
adds-extra-damage.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 24 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Replacement effects that add a number to damage dealt by your sources (doubling has its own replacement group). Phase 2: a replacement that adds a number to damage dealt is not a field (doubling has its own replacement group).

gives-a-permanent-to-another-player.name: Gives a permanent you control to another player
gives-a-permanent-to-another-player.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 4 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that give control of a permanent you control to another player. Phase 2: control passing to another player by your choice is not a field.

any: gains control of target permanent you control

suspects-a-creature.name: Suspects creatures
suspects-a-creature.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 22 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that suspect creatures or care about suspected creatures. Phase 2: the suspect state (menace, can't block) is not a field.

collects-evidence.name: Collects evidence
collects-evidence.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 25 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that collect evidence. Phase 2: collect evidence (exile cards from a graveyard by total mana value) is not a field.

forages.name: Forages
forages.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 10 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that forage. Phase 2: forage (exile three cards or sacrifice a Food) is not a field.

draws-to-catch-up-on-cards.name: Draws to catch up when an opponent has more cards in hand
draws-to-catch-up-on-cards.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 3 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that draw cards equal to the difference when an opponent has more cards in hand. Tightened from 'draws cards equal to a hand-size difference' (11 matches, 8 of them refill-to-N effects that are already placed). Phase 2: a draw count taken from the difference between hand sizes is not a field.

any: more cards in hand than you, draw cards equal to

damages-each-opponent-and-their-creature.note: Read on 2026-10-16 against all 9 matches in the 33,183-card scope; no false hit found. Cards that deal damage to each opponent and each creature they control in one effect. Phase 2: damage to a player and to everything that player controls in one effect is not a field.

each opponent and each creature they control
